items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Dave Barber did guitar, Al Casey, Alan Reuse as you say, Freddie Green, Al Casey.

ctx.x: Yeah, Allen Reuss. And Harry James did some trumpet. Dave Barber did guitar, Al Casey, Alan Reuse as you say, Freddie Green, Al Casey. Then the very first session, it may have been or most successful one in a way, John Truhart was on guitar on that one. Benny Morton practically -- I don't think we ever had another trombone player, it was Benny Morton all the time.

You know, looking back on it and the history of the Billie Holiday recordings and all the different things she did with all those people like Eddie Heywood and Tony Scott, the record shows that your records were the most fabulous. And we talked about the -- I don't think anything ever topped "Miss Brown, To You," and "What a little the Moonlight Could Do," and what about those sessions. How'd you guys get that impossible sound?
